title: Noetherianity of canonical strict henselization
statement: Let R be regular and barY a geometric point of Spec R. The canonical strict henselization ring is Noetherian.

source.place: Tag 0EYG (pione-lemma-abhyankar-one-divisor), strict henselization paragraph; Tag 05WS (lemma-quotient-strict-henselization); Tag 06LN, regularity under strict henselization.

proof.text: Use the retained upstream proof for the full affine-neighbourhood colimit. The quotient R/(0) is isomorphic to R and hence regular. The canonical strict henselization is local and nontrivial; its zero element is a nonunit. Apply the regular-divisor quotient theorem with f = 0, obtain Noetherianity from regularity of the quotient, and transfer it across the zero-ideal quotient equivalence. For the small-colimit formulation in the sole consumer, comparison_base identifies the structural maps under smallStrictHenselizationColimitIso. Apply the retained theorem to b composed with this comparison and transfer Noetherianity along the inverse comparison by isNoetherianRing_of_ringEquiv.
